reviews.text:
An extraordinary veterinary team with exceptional kindness!

I entrust my cats to this clinic and I couldn't dream of anything better.

The entire team of veterinarians is wonderful, extremely competent, attentive, and passionate.

My cats have always been treated with great professionalism, and they have always recovered thanks to their accurate diagnoses and rigorous follow-up care.

I particularly want to emphasize the dignity, empathy, and gentleness they demonstrated during the euthanasia of one of my cats. In those incredibly painful moments, their support was immensely comforting, and everything unfolded with complete serenity.

A huge thank you to the entire team for the heartfelt care they provided. You can go there with complete confidence!

Bowie and I were seen in an emergency setting and received a very compassionate welcome. Dr. Le Bail was very gentle and professional in delivering her diagnosis. The report was received promptly after the consultation. I highly recommend this clinic.

This clinic clearly values ​​money more than animals. After an emergency consultation to have three staples inserted, it was agreed that I would return free of charge to have them removed 10 days later. In the meantime, my cat's eye started to ooze. I asked the vet to take a look. After a three-minute examination and a diagnosis of conjunctivitis, I was shocked to find myself having to pay full price for another consultation. €200 in 10 days for eye drops, three stitches, and an Elizabethan collar. Despite my protests, the vet couldn't see the problem. Never again.

Delighted, kind, and attentive.
Available.
I recommend.

Thank you to Dr. Gres for his advice, gentleness, and kindness.
I highly recommend him!

One star, and even then…

I had a particularly unpleasant experience with the receptionist on Friday, September 4th at 5:50 pm. Her attitude was simply appalling: she looked me up and down, barely said hello, and spoke to me in a curt, cold, and extremely rude manner.

All I did was ask for my dog's medication. The person before me received big smiles and a warm welcome, while with me, the treatment was completely different. It's hard not to feel that she's acting based on who she is.

Even more concerning: she didn't even ask me my dog's weight, even though this information is essential for determining the dosage of certain medications. Even if this information is already in the file, it seems crucial to verify it to avoid any potentially dangerous errors.

When you go to the vet, it's usually because you're worried about your pet. You therefore expect a minimum of humanity, respect, and kindness. If she dislikes interacting with clients so much, perhaps she should consider a profession that doesn't require public contact.

The reception was deplorable and the attitude frankly appalling. I certainly didn't expect to be received this way in a veterinary clinic.

A clinic where you'll find both exceptional professionalism and great compassion. My 14-year-old dog was treated there for 9 years (primarily by Dr. Jumelet). Her passing was handled thoughtfully and admirably. Thank you.
Excellent clinic. Very welcoming and professional staff! And incredibly empathetic. I go there without hesitation! Thank you
Thank you very much.
They are very experienced.

Absolutely no empathy. Refused to dispense medication for a cat despite a prescription from a fellow veterinarian. Just a simple medication for hyperthyroidism.

Update following the veterinarian's response: The veterinarian's response, hiding behind regulations, is appalling, especially since no contextual questions were raised. Furthermore, the regulation's response is highly questionable, as this medication can be dispensed at a pharmacy with a veterinary prescription. Which is what I did.

One thing is certain: you will never see any of my cats for a consultation.
Very friendly and competent staff. Highly professional.
Excellent clinic!
She refuses to dispense prescription medication and demands payment for a consultation; on top of that, she's arrogant—avoid her!

Vet visit for my cat. Friendly welcome, very gentle consultation with lots of explanations and information. My cat wasn't very cooperative, but Dr. Grès was perfect and very professional. Thank you so much! :)

I took my dog Sam here last month for an emergency surgery with no appointment, and they worked on her immediately. she had suffered a severe degloving injury to the skin on her belly and I was exhausted from carrying her 2 kilometers because she couldn't walk after the accident. The vet on duty was named Baptiste - he and a colleague worked very hard to repair Sam's wound with MANY stitches, and did a wonderful job in a very grave and unexpected circumstance.
After the successful procedure, I took Sam in for multiple checkups with Dr. le Bail to receive more medicine and care instructions - at one point she even needed a secondary surgery to remove some dead skin on the wound. The care was very thorough and my dog recovered perfectly! She has a crescent shaped scar on her belly now, but she doesn't feel self conscious about it because she is a dog. I am very grateful for the care and attention to save my dog's life, and the rates were very reasonable in my opinion (especially compared to the USA). It was an intense way to find a new vet for my dog after moving to Paris, but now I have a great vet for Sam! 6/5 stars ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
A professional who listens and truly seeks the causes of her patients' pathologies.

My cats were treated at this veterinary clinic for a while, and everything was fine until one day a problem arose that could have cost my pet their life. At that point, the clinic manager completely shirked her responsibilities!
All she could do was put me in touch with her insurance company, which she had briefed beforehand so that I wouldn't get anywhere with this claim. This experience highlights the unreliability and lack of professionalism of this clinic, because it's only when problems arise that you see what kind of people you're dealing with!

By far the best clinic in Paris. My first cat was treated there, and they were there for me during his final days. My second cat was treated there for almost two years afterward. The staff is always available and welcoming, whether for an emergency or routine check-up! I'm very sad that I can no longer go there due to moving. I recommend them without hesitation.

Highly professional, serious, available, and approachable veterinarians. Gentle and patient with animals, and their prices are very reasonable. They take the time to explain everything thoroughly! I highly recommend them!
chief veterinarian
Thank you for this very positive feedback.
I highly recommend this clinic! They are kind, offer quick appointments, and are very professional. My dogs have been treated there for years. Romy wishes her favorite vet happy holidays! 😉 …
Thank you very much
Good team, good advice, very professional!

Received in an emergency for my small dog, the whole team is lovely!
Thank you so much!
THANKS
Hello, I'm very disappointed with this clinic and I don't recommend it. I know something.
Your comment means a lot to us. Thank you.
The entire team thanks you for your trust.
This is not a good clinic; I strongly advise against it.
A clinic that takes care of our companion animals. Personally, I'm delighted. From the welcome and the attentive listening to the advice...

My little César and I met Dr. Le Bail for the first time this afternoon. He received a wonderful welcome and even a little toy that he immediately took to... What a thoughtful touch! Thank you for taking the time to see him/us.

A special mention also goes to the team: attentive, caring, and available. I had the same feeling during our initial interactions. My call when my dog ​​started experiencing side effects from the vaccines confirmed it. Thank you to you all as well!

Our experience is sadly tragic, as our little Nala had to be euthanized. However, we thank Dr. JUMELET for his helpful advice during the initial visit, and Dr. GRES, who gently and professionally put our little cat to sleep. We highly recommend this clinic. No unnecessary treatments and very fair prices. Thank you!
Excellent veterinary clinic. We are always well received and our dog is very well cared for here.
Always perfect. Excellent welcome and excellent veterinarian.
Thank you so much
Thank you for saving my cat 🐈 The vet and assistant were fantastic, very professional, and explained things clearly. Thank you! …
Dr. Le Bail is truly wonderful! Thank you again for taking such kind care of the animals.
Very welcoming and very professional

Hello,
This message is dedicated to Dr. L. Le Bail's clinic, and especially to Dr. Laure Le Bail. A truly professional, calm, gentle, patient, and animal lover.
Laure Le Bail provided medical care for my little Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, Enzo, who was 14 years and 12 days old. She was always kind and provided excellent treatment. Enzo also had surgery at this clinic, and everything went very well. My beloved Enzo passed away peacefully (without suffering) on ​​April 1, 2025, with Dr. Laure Le Bail and me by his side.

I sincerely thank Dr. L. Le Bail and her team, as well as the morning veterinary assistant, whose name escapes me.

I highly recommend this veterinary clinic in the 15th arrondissement of Paris; it is very professional and offers fair and reasonable prices.

Sincerely,
Mrs. C. Michel
Absolute disaster!!! This is indeed place only after money! They don’t care about your pet! Every action needs additional cost! Please avoid at all cost

We were very disappointed with our visit to this vet. The reception was fine with the staff, but the rest was impersonal. We didn't feel any real concern for our pet, only a very money-oriented approach. For us, money is never an issue when it comes to caring for our animal, but here, there was no connection whatsoever. The overall atmosphere was very cold, and we felt uncomfortable. A good vet should prioritize the well-being of animals, but we felt it was primarily a business. We do not recommend them!

An extremely traumatic experience!!! I strongly advise against this clinic.

I went to the emergency room with my cat in respiratory distress.
We were seen by a man who, according to him, was a veterinarian. He downplayed the seriousness of the situation, claiming that "it wasn't an emergency" because my cat "still had a pink tongue."

For nearly 40 minutes, he simply called an absent veterinarian—his manager—without ever making a diagnosis or administering any real care. He even filmed my cat to send her a video so she could tell him what to do.

He ended up injecting my pet with a product, without a clear explanation, supposedly to "calm him down."
My cat died in my arms five minutes later.

It was only after her death that he admitted he wasn't a veterinarian, but a student.
No emergency procedures, no appropriate care!

When I refused to pay the cremation fee, the police were called. I had to explain the whole situation to them. In the end, I wasn't responsible for the cremation fee, but this outcome will never change what happened.

Unacceptable treatment!!! This clinic should not be allowed to operate like this.
Thank you very much for your trust.
Norm

The vet was very gentle with my cat (she had her spayed), very attentive to my concerns, and did everything she could to reassure me. The whole team has a genuine love for animals, and it shows—which is incredibly important when you have to leave your pet overnight!
Thank you so much

My cat has always received excellent care, seen promptly when needed, by both the regular vet and the on-call vet. The staff are always pleasant and gentle with the animals. Thank you for the quality of your work.
He listened very carefully and offered us alternatives and trials for the treatment of our cat.

Honestly, I had a problem on Sunday and had to call several vets. The difference is striking; at this clinic, I received advice that prioritized the well-being of my animals above all else. These are people who think about animals before their business. It deserves 5 stars.
My puppy is well cared for and looked after! They are lovely with animals... I recommend them!
She was incredibly kind and tender with my cat, who is quite timid! Very reassuring and always offered sound advice on our cat's health and hygiene!
THANKS
Thank you very much.
Satisfied
Thank you very much for your feedback.

I loved my visit to this clinic. My cat came in injured on a Saturday, my vet was closed, I called and they found me an appointment for the same day. A great team, Dr. Le Bail was really reassuring, attentive, and did everything with kindness and gentleness... the kindness and compassion are there, it really makes you feel good.

Excellent care for my dog, Luna.

A very good team; I was warmly welcomed by the nurses. Luna's surgery, performed by Dr. Lebail, went very well.
I am more than satisfied with my experience at the clinic.
I highly recommend it.
